framework: standard interferometric measurement theory plus classical Fisher information from fringe or phase-space visibility

findings: Define q_hat from an interference readout channel, not mass inversion. Candidate readouts: normalized visibility, Wigner negativity/parity oscillation amplitude, or coherent peak area. Mass is only a sample label/covariate. For m_obs>m_star, do not observe imaginary q; test whether the constrained DGF mass-q model fails against environmental/null likelihood.

q_independent_readout.definition: Scan controlled phase phi or cat phase theta; fit P(y|phi)=P0(y)*(1+V*cos(phi+phi0))/N; define q_hat=(2/pi)*asin(clip(V/V_ref,0,1)), or replace V with Wigner interference amplitude A_int. V_ref is a same-device calibrated maximum/short-time reference, not computed from m.

nonreal_qinv_to_observable.minimal_model: Compare M0: V(t)=V_env(t) with M1_DGF: V(t)=V_env(t)*exp(-Gamma_q(q_hat,t)*t), constrained by m_obs=(2*m_p/pi)*sin(pi*q/2), q in [0,1]. For m_obs>m_star, M1_DGF cannot map mass to real q; treat as constrained-model failure, not direct observable.

experiment_path: Primary: reanalyze Bild et al./Fadel 16 microgram mechanical cat platform. Extract cat size, phase, decoherence time series, parity/Wigner or tomography-derived interference amplitude vs delay. Fit visibility-derived q_hat independently, then test whether the DGF mass-q constraint predicts q_hat/t-dependence.
weakest_link: V/V_ref to q calibration is phenomenological; must prove same q fluctuation drives GUP-Lindblad beta(q,t)->K(t), otherwise Petruzziello-Illuminati 2021 remains prior art.

claims.statement: q can be made non-circular by defining it from fringe or phase-space interference visibility, not from mass inversion.
assumptions: V_ref is independent of mass inversion
visibility channel is calibrated and not dominated by environmental loss

claims.statement: m>2*m_p/pi is a constrained-model rejection condition tested through likelihood of visibility data.
assumptions: observable visibility remains measurable with quantified uncertainty
